description: What AI training jobs pay, from live listings that state an hourly rate: 25th percentile, median, 75th and 90th percentile of top rates, with the platforms hiring most. Optionally for one field and/or one country (listings that name the country or say worldwide).

country.description: Where the person lives: a country name, slug or ISO code (e.g. "India", "united-states", "PH"). "any" turns the filter off.

field.description: Field of expertise: software (Engineers, data scientists, ML people); medicine (Physicians, nurses, dentists, clinicians); science (Physicists, chemists, biologists, engineers); math (Mathematicians, statisticians, theorem provers); finance (Analysts, accountants, bankers, consultants); law (Attorneys, paralegals, compliance experts); language (Native speakers, translators, linguists); audio (Voice actors, transcribers, recorders); writing (Writers, editors, copywriters); design (Designers, illustrators, artists, musicians); humanities (Teachers, professors, historians, social scientists); general (Evaluators and raters, often no degree needed).

name: pay_stats
title: Pay for a field and country
